official_attempt.source: User-provided report from the official Mac local task

independent_check.source: Current Windows session read-only cloud plugin task query

interpretation.rule: If the driver has not independently confirmed an effect, an expect value that was already visible before the action cannot promote the receipt to succeeded.
interpretation.conclusion: The reported unchanged zero display is consistent with this evidence rule and does not establish whether clear executed.
interpretation.limitations: Raw native action and immediate verification responses were not retained; other causes of unknown cannot be excluded from the public receipt alone.

continuation: Keep the original clear-all receipt unchanged and do not resend clear under the same or a new identifier
In the original official Mac task, rediscover and observe the full current Windows Calculator state
Only if the display is zero and no pending expression is present, use that observed baseline to continue with the previously unsent digit-4, multiply, digit-9 and equals actions
Use fresh observations, exact Windows AX expectations and one dispatch per action; inspect uncertain effects before deciding whether a distinct next action is justified
Report the original unknown separately from any newly verified actions and the final result; do not claim five successful receipts
For a separate clear-specific test, first establish a verified nonzero state so that clearing produces an observable transition
privacy: Device identifiers, nonce, private paths, cloud file identifiers, images and input contents omitted from public record
